prediction.scope: Six outer participant folds; five inner participant folds crossed with omitted positions. Each family selects extraction, smoothing and fitting using training participants only. Outer predictions also omit the target position from fitting. Inner selection sees all design positions in training participants. Evaluation conditions on profiles cleaned beforehand using each person's eligible AT and Baseline hit RTs across all positions. People do not share cleaning thresholds, but an omitted position can affect its own person's threshold. This is relative-profile prediction for new people at the known design, not end-to-end prediction from uncleaned trials; families/criteria were developed post hoc. Overlapping training sets preclude treating folds as independent replicates or this evaluation as a confirmatory test.

raw_curvature.method: Post hoc Hotelling T-squared on three orthonormal contrasts orthogonal to intercept and distance; raw unsmoothed participant means. Assumes independent people, multivariate-normal contrasts and nonsingular covariance. All four p values unadjusted. Detects any nonlinearity, not specifically an S shape; a large p value does not establish linearity.

group_shape.interpretation: Post-results exclusion-cohort audit. Nested scores compare five response families on the same cleaned-profile target. Log distance is not an expectancy control. Nine geometry specifications are all reported with frozen preprocessing; their leave-position scores are descriptive and use all people. Thirty repeated-selection resamples diagnose instability, not tail confidence coverage. Original cleaning is fixed; no serial-dependence or physiological validation is claimed.
